name: Three-cell player moves north without splitting
description:
The three-cell player, including its raised cell, moves north as one body. An internal player cell must never be treated as a separate carrier. No gem is present in this scene.

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Player: 3 cells, starting at (0, 5, 1) through (1, 5, 2). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
